favourite.heading: Why Georgia can pull away
bullets: Georgia is the better football team by 5.7 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 74% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (+5.7 pts).
Playing at Georgia is worth 4.1 points — the league-wide home-field number, because a per-venue table was tested and could not be told apart from the home team’s own quality (+4.1 pts).

underdog.heading: Why Oklahoma can keep it close
bullets: Stylistically the matchup favours Oklahoma by 1.1 points: field position (-1.1 pts).
The outcome range is 15.3 points wide at one sigma — p10 -14.4 to p90 +29.6 for Georgia, so a projection of +8.6 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 4%.
College ratings are built on twelve-game seasons against wildly uneven schedules; even a clean rating gap carries more estimation error than the number implies.
